title: Chimes and Pleasure (Base (Naked Audio))
description: I love playing with sounds and stimuli. I've found that auditory association can be such a fun way to spark joy in others, in unexpectedly delightful ways. So when I passed by a bunch of awesome vendors during my recent time at a Renaissance Fair, and I heard this Tingsha bell ring out... Well, naturally, I was drawn to this particular booth, with their fun little brass-looking chime things, and just started to play with them. It's these two chimes connected by a leather string, and all it takes is to drop the one chime onto the other to set them ringing. And all I could think in that moment was that these would be perfect for making into a file... I wasn't sure what, but I'd make one for them. And so I did. "Chimes and Pleasure" is the result... part relaxing meditation, part sensual hypnosis. A gentle vanilla file that I hope shares in that ringing moment of joie de vivre, and brings you your own enjoyment and appreciation for these small playful bells. All I ask is you let my hands and my voice guide you deeper into a world where pleasure can come from a chime. One where letting yourself go allows you to chime with worldly pleasures.
author: Mistress Shibby
